dataset.source: Original NYC TLC yellow taxi monthly parquet files
dataset.qualification: Saved cleaned-matrix total includes the notebook’s gap/DST processing; not a fresh recount of raw trip records.

splits.name: Training
splits.period: Jan, Mar, Apr, Jun, Jul, Aug, Oct, Dec 2025

experiment.selection: Notebook reports the GNN selected by lowest mean validation MAE across all five horizons, excluding random-control GCN and bracket-tagged variants. Test-set leaders are reported separately.
experiment.robustnessMessage: The supplied saved outputs do not contain a multi-seed robustness or context-ablation result table.
models: Weekly moving average (up to 4 same-month weeks)
experiment.monthBoundaryRule: All 168 history hours and 24 target hours remain within a single assigned calendar month.

graphs.name: Contiguity
graphs.construction: 50-foot buffered polygon intersections; isolated zones connected to three nearest neighbors.

graphs.name: Distance (kNN)
graphs.construction: Gaussian distance weights over eight nearest zones; symmetrized.

graphs.name: OD flow
graphs.construction: Log two-way flow, ten strongest positive links per zone; symmetrized.

graphs.name: Correlation
graphs.construction: Positive residual log-demand correlation after removing training hour-of-week means; ten strongest links.

results.message: Reported saved notebook results on held-out February and September 2025; not an independent rerun or current-demand accuracy measurement.

deployment.message: The selected notebook model and deployed export share the reported architecture, 168-hour input and five horizons. The uploaded notebook contains no weight-file hash linking its benchmark scores to the currently deployed ONNX bytes. Current-date estimates still lack observed current pickups.

limitations: Saved output snapshot supplied by the project owner; no independent retraining or raw-data recount was performed.
Training months include dates later than the held-out months. This tests held-out-month generalization within 2025, not forward-only deployment performance.
The selected GNN is not the lowest-MAE test model at every horizon or subset; distance + OD is lower at 12/24 hours, and event/holiday errors need separate review.
The notebook imputes suspected zero-count gaps using training profiles and excludes gap/DST target cells; metrics reflect those masks.
All cell execution counters are cleared although outputs remain. Full-precision result CSVs, checkpoints and repeated-seed results are not attached.
The paper display repeats the seasonal residual row. Its duplicate values were cross-checked against the complete benchmark table.
